bio-u01.title: The Epitranscriptome: RNA Modifications and RNA Catalysis In Vivo
bio-u01.focus: Cover the chemistry and regulation of internal RNA modifications - m6A (DRACH motif, METTL3/14 writers, YTHDF readers, the contested FTO/ALKBH5 eraser story), pseudouridine, m5C, and A-to-I editing - and how the 2'-OH enables RNA to act as catalyst and metabolite sensor (ribozymes, riboswitches), deepening the DNA/RNA chemical contrast. bio-u01.title: Measuring the Macromolecular World: Quantitative Proteomics and Multiomics Integration
bio-u01.focus: Explain bottom-up LC-MS/MS proteomics mechanistically - enzymatic digestion, electrospray ionization, MS1/MS2 scans, DDA vs DIA, TMT vs label-free quantification - and the resulting data properties: 10^7+ dynamic range, stochastic missingness, the peptide-to-protein inference problem, and PTM-enrichment workflows (phosphoproteomics) that quantify regulatory states invisible to RNA-seq.
